qAndA.answer: Green leaves are dropped into the water.

qAndA.answer: It drains straight down without spinning.
qAndA.question: How does the water drain at the equator?
In which direction does the water drain 2 meters south of the equator?

qAndA.answer: The Coriolis effect, caused by the Earth's rotation, influences the direction of moving objects.

activities.description: Woman in White Hat drops leaves into the water.
Water drains from the basin without spinning.
Woman in White Hat refills the basin.
Water drains from the basin, spinning clockwise.

youtube_description:
What happens with water at the equator vs. what happens with water 2 meters south and what happens 2 meters north of the equator.

Explore the intriguing science of the Coriolis effect at the Equator with our visit to Ecuador's renowned Intiñan Museum. Witness firsthand how water rotates differently on each side of the Equator in this captivating demonstration. Join us on this unique journey where science meets the wonders of nature at the heart of Ecuador. Don't forget to subscribe for more amazing science explorations!
